purpose: N19/#1351: enforce the internal native-engine module graph, deny reverse dependencies on host crates, pin the crate feature surface, and run the policy through the normal local boundary lane.
profileModulesNote: The seventeen production modules under native-engine/src. The integration harness files in native-engine/tests remain registered and size-checked by rust.profile.json, but are outside this crate-source graph.

native-root.meaning: lib.rs is the declaration-only crate root and may expose each feature-gated production module.

native-document.meaning: The document model is the dependency floor.

native-codec.meaning: Serialization consumes only the document model.

native-request-receipts.meaning: Request identity and replay receipts are independent infrastructure.

native-revision.meaning: Snapshots and revision ownership consume only the document model.

native-commands.meaning: Commands operate on documents with revision and request identity contracts.

native-history.meaning: history.rs and transaction.rs form one authority facade and consume the command/document contracts.

native-resource-leases.meaning: Resource lifetime ownership keys leases to document snapshots.

native-scheduler.meaning: Scheduling owns work and lease lifetimes.

native-render-scene.meaning: Render-scene preparation consumes evaluation and scheduled identity only.

native-compositor.meaning: The compositor consumes prepared render scenes.

native-desktop-viewport.meaning: The viewport presents compositor output under scheduler identity.

native-png-output.meaning: PNG output consumes the same prepared scene and compositor port as preview.

native-export-job.meaning: Export coordinates immutable history snapshots, scheduling, resource leases and PNG output.

native-protocol.meaning: The wire-neutral application protocol translates commands and export results.

native-application.meaning: The application facade composes the native authority without depending on a host shell.

permittedEdges.note: Observed at adoption from use and inline crate paths. Layer rules are the enforced contract; the test suite pins the exact observed 38-edge graph so additions require a reviewed policy change.

exportedPort.source: native-engine/src/lib.rs exposes modules through a declaration macro rather than pub use; N19 tests pin that macro and its Cargo mapping separately.

features.declaredNote: Exact [features] keys from native-engine/Cargo.toml. The declaration macro uses a metavariable cfg; the N19 test pins every production and test mapping to Cargo and proves a literal undeclared feature is rejected.

tauri.note: The engine cannot depend on the desktop host.

nemo_mcp.note: The engine cannot depend on the MCP transport.

geometry_wasm.note: The native engine cannot reverse-depend on the legacy WebAssembly engine.

nemo.note: The engine cannot depend on the desktop crate by its package name.
